heard: NASA's first Mars rover was the size of a microwave. This 23-pound micro rover reached the surface wrapped in giant airbags. The craft in land, it bounced across a Martian floodplain. Sojourner arrived in 1997, named for civil rights activist Sojourner Truth. Engineers only expected the tiny robot to survive seven days. It lasted 85 days, proving Mars was once warm and wet. Today, its silhouette is etched onto the deck of the Perseverance rover. It's a permanent tribute to the robot built like a microwave.
